metadata.purpose: Record attributable and current policy positions; party proposals are not enacted government policy.
metadata.caveat: Source-linked register of selected published party positions, not a complete manifesto-by-manifesto comparison. Government parties' positions are distinguished from adopted Government policy. Absence from this register does not mean a party has no policy on an area.

positions.policy_area: Housing, health, cost of living, education, disability
positions.position_summary: Alternative Budget 2027 prioritises targeted child and energy supports, expanded public and affordable housing, childcare, health capacity and income-tax indexation.
positions.proposal_text: Proposals include a €400 targeted energy credit, 6,000 public childcare places, more than 6,000 social and affordable homes annually with a stated public-build target of 22,000, a second-tier Child Benefit, weekly welfare increases, expanded GP care and disability supports.
positions.costing_source: Party budget publication; verify detailed costing tables in original document
positions.status: Party proposal — not enacted government policy

positions.policy_area: Housing, health, taxation, childcare, disability, cost of living
positions.position_summary: Alternative Budget 2027 proposes targeted household supports and long-term public capacity investment.
positions.proposal_text: Proposals include a €400 targeted energy credit, €300 monthly childcare fee reduction, additional State-led social and affordable housing and modular home factories, a €1bn-plus Sláintecare and health staffing investment, and a 2% wealth tax on assets over €5m.
positions.costing_source: Party Alternative Budget 2027; verify detailed costing tables in original document
positions.status: Party proposal — not enacted government policy

positions.policy_area: Housing, taxation, cost of living, health, public services
positions.position_summary: Budget 2027 proposals reported in October 2026 emphasise household cost supports, tax changes and increased social and affordable housing.
positions.proposal_text: Reported proposals include a €500 Everyday Essentials Card for one million lower-income households, €400 electricity credit, USC changes, increased social and affordable housing investment and a doubling of the renters tax credit. Treat these as a press-reported summary pending source-document extraction.
positions.costing_source: Secondary reporting of party budget; original party costing document should be linked before final assessment

positions.position_summary: Budget 2027 proposals reported in October 2026 emphasise direct public provision, price interventions and higher taxation on wealth and excess profits.
positions.proposal_text: Reported proposals include expanded State housing construction, household energy credits, abolishing energy standing charges and price caps. Treat these as a press-reported summary pending original source-document extraction.
positions.costing_source: Secondary reporting; obtain original party document and costings

positions.position_summary: Government party. Its published housing policy supports home ownership, a 300,000-home pathway to 2030, Help to Buy and cost-rental housing. Government budget measures must be distinguished from party-only proposals.
positions.proposal_text: Published housing page describes Help to Buy (up to €30,000 under stated conditions), cost-rental homes and a 300,000-home pathway. Its Budget 2027 speech announces allocations for health, justice and defence as Government policy. The party-published completion figure should be reconciled with CSO definitions before use.
positions.costing_source: Party housing page; Budget 2027 Ministerial speech for Government allocations
positions.status: Government party position; distinguish manifesto/policy statements from enacted and funded Government measures

positions.position_summary: Government party. Published priorities include increasing housing supply and home ownership, faster international-protection processing and returns after due process, Garda investment, prison capacity and victim-centred justice.
positions.proposal_text: Housing policy page proposes 60,000 homes annually, 18,000 homes through the Land Development Agency and expanded first-time-buyer supports. Its migration and justice page advocates faster processing, stronger border security, returns of unsuccessful applicants subject to law, Garda recruitment and additional prison places. These are party commitments; check the Programme for Government and Budget for adopted Government policy.
positions.costing_source: Fine Gael published policy pages and Budget 2027 programme; full independent costing not assessed here
positions.status: Government party position; party targets are not proof of delivery

positions.position_summary: The Green Party's published policies emphasise compact, transit-oriented development, stronger public and affordable housing, lower-carbon transport and accelerated household energy transition.
positions.proposal_text: Housing policy supports a right-to-home constitutional amendment, a Land Use Authority, public and community housing, retrofit of vacant buildings and stronger rental security. Its Budget 2027 submission proposes a €2.5bn Fossil Fuel Inflation Fund, childcare wage support, phased abolition of the student contribution charge, reversal of a planned public-transport fare increase and a data-centre energy levy. These are party proposals, not adopted Government measures.
positions.publication_date: Housing policy page; Budget 2027 submission 1 October 2026
positions.costing_source: Green Party Budget 2027 submission; detailed costing assumptions require independent review
positions.status: Opposition party proposal; some standing policy pages pre-date the current Dáil term
